description: This file defines the CountryFixture class used for testing purposes within the OrangeHRM project. It extends an abstract fixture class and provides a method to retrieve data representing countries from the database, formatted for use in tests. It also specifies the filename associated with this fixture.

classes.name: CountryFixture
classes.description: A test fixture class that loads country data from the database for testing purposes.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves all Country entities from the database and formats their properties into an array suitable for testing fixtures.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with this fixture, 'Country.yaml'.
